### Finalize allows vault substitution **High Severity** `FinalizeSettlement` reads `profit_vault.amount` to record paymaster and treasury shares but does not bind the vault with `address = config.profit_vault`, unlike prepare, distribute, and settle. Any token account with the same mint and vault-authority owner can inflate recorded shares, leaving settlement stuck or later draining the real vault if it is topped up.
Additional Locations (1) - [`programs/shadow_paymaster/src/lib.rs#L95-L101`](https://github.com/Adaptive-Liquidity/Shadow-Pro/blob/aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1/programs/shadow_paymaster/src/lib.rs#L95-L101)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Expired relay status not terminal **Medium Severity** `getStatus` reports `Invalid` after expiry without persisting that terminal state, so `setStatus` still sees `Pending` and can rewrite an expired bundle to `Landed` or `Failed`. That breaks the harness rule that expiry is terminal and acknowledgement is not landing.
Additional Locations (1) - [`composer/src/fake-relay.ts#L45-L57`](https://github.com/Adaptive-Liquidity/Shadow-Pro/blob/aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1/composer/src/fake-relay.ts#L45-L57)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Invalid expiry bypasses check **Medium Severity** `verifySignReceipt` treats receipt expiry as failed only when `Date.parse(expiresAt) <= now`. Unparseable `expiresAt` values yield `NaN`, and `NaN <= now` is false, so malformed expiry strings skip the expiry gate and still proceed to signature verification.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Program ID config mismatch **Medium Severity** `declare_id!` uses the Anchor template pubkey, while `Anchor.toml` and `sources.lock.json` pin `ShdwPymstr…`. Localnet deploy, IDL, and source-lock identity therefore disagree on the program ID.
Additional Locations (2) - [`Anchor.toml#L4-L6`](https://github.com/Adaptive-Liquidity/Shadow-Pro/blob/aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1/Anchor.toml#L4-L6) - [`config/sources.lock.json#L5-L8`](https://github.com/Adaptive-Liquidity/Shadow-Pro/blob/aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1/config/sources.lock.json#L5-L8)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Anchor lock skips IDL pin **Medium Severity** `sourceLockAllowsExecution` requires `idl_sha256` only for `external-program` entries. An `anchor-program` marked `pinned` with a null IDL hash still counts as executable, despite the lock entry stating an IDL hash is required before deployment.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit aaf810c385f4fa286af3918271f76618a6de31c1. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Weak borrow/payback presence check **Medium Severity** The extractor only checks that the filtered instruction count equals two. An IDL with two `flashloan_borrow` entries and no `flashloan_payback` (or the reverse) still passes, so the matrix can omit a required instruction while looking valid.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit d2bbd3ceb7597ff2b46817585faeade868af00c5. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Wrong Instructions sysvar pin **High Severity** `INSTRUCTION_SYSVAR` is truncated to `Sysvar1nstructions1111111111111` instead of the IDL and Solana Instructions sysvar `Sysvar1nstructions1111111111111111111111111`. The fixed-account check therefore rejects real Jupiter Flashloan metas and the mirrored test constant hides the mismatch.
Additional Locations (2) - [`composer/src/jupiter-flashloan.ts#L69-L70`](https://github.com/Adaptive-Liquidity/Shadow-Pro/blob/2aee6b8f4d216ecffd02dfd27da577ad5c61c7a3/composer/src/jupiter-flashloan.ts#L69-L70) - [`composer/test/jupiter-flashloan.test.ts#L12-L13`](https://github.com/Adaptive-Liquidity/Shadow-Pro/blob/2aee6b8f4d216ecffd02dfd27da577ad5c61c7a3/composer/test/jupiter-flashloan.test.ts#L12-L13)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 2aee6b8f4d216ecffd02dfd27da577ad5c61c7a3. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Pair gate ignores account binding **Medium Severity** `validateFlashloanBorrowPaybackPair` only checks count, kind, ordinal, and amount. `DecodedFlashloanInstruction` drops account pubkeys, so borrow and payback can target different mint, vault, or token accounts and still pass the pair gate.
Additional Locations (1) - [`composer/src/jupiter-flashloan.ts#L23-L29`](https://github.com/Adaptive-Liquidity/Shadow-Pro/blob/2aee6b8f4d216ecffd02dfd27da577ad5c61c7a3/composer/src/jupiter-flashloan.ts#L23-L29)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 2aee6b8f4d216ecffd02dfd27da577ad5c61c7a3. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Unset-values guard fails open **Medium Severity** The deny-by-default CI guard treats a missing or empty `required_unset_values` object as success because of `?? {}` and a loop that only checks whatever keys happen to be present. Removing that section, emptying it, or deleting critical keys like `agent_public_key` / `rpc_endpoint` still passes CI, so the template can stop enforcing “no committed identities or endpoints” without detection.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 09cb57f344226b8eb861112da55e020eeb2584c0. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Anchor cluster check is brittle **Medium Severity** The `Anchor.toml` readiness check only searches for the substrings `cluster = "Localnet"` and `LOCAL_ONLY_DO_NOT_FUND`. A commented or leftover Localnet marker can satisfy the guard even when the live provider `cluster` is switched to Devnet or Mainnet, so CI may still report localnet-only readiness.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 09cb57f344226b8eb861112da55e020eeb2584c0. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).
